name: Kate Williams
story: Kate Williams was named with Kate Burns and James Lyth of Tonkin & Taylor as a recipient of the 2012 Eagle Technology Excellence in GIS Award for the Canterbury Earthquake Residential Land Damage application. This entry records her named contribution to that award, without assuming later career details.
